mentions.name: DBConvert Streams
mentions.description: A self-hosted database IDE with built-in migration, CDC (change data capture), and DuckDB-powered federated SQL. Current focus is on resumable large loads and a cleaner handoff from initial load to CDC for Postgres and MySQL.
mentions.problem: Removing the gap between being able to inspect a database and being able to safely move or sync its data somewhere else.

mentions.name: DBConvert Streams
mentions.description: This tool provides database tooling for data movement and change data capture (CDC), collapsing what normally requires stitching together a SQL IDE, export scripts, a pipeline, and CDC tooling into a single workflow. It runs locally or via Docker without requiring Kafka or heavy setup.
mentions.problem: Database data movement and CDC workflows usually require stitching 3-4 tools together (SQL IDE, export/scripts, pipeline, CDC, back to SQL) and heavy setups like Kafka; this collapses them into one workflow.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on database tooling around data movement + CDC.

Trying to collapse what is usually:

SQL IDE -> export/scripts -> pipeline -> CDC -> back to SQL

into a single workflow instead of stitching 3–4 tools together.

Runs locally or via Docker, no Kafka / heavy setup.

https://streams.dbconvert.com/
